text:
ryan: ugh deploy-bot flagged a regression on dedicated pool eu-west2 — embeddings p95 jumped ~40% and trigger_count=3. looks like it's right at the autorevert threshold.

deploy-bot: ALERT: dedicated/eu-west2 | route=embeddings | p95_latency=520ms (+40%) | trigger_count=3 | auto_revert_threshold=3 | action=AUTO_REVERT_POSSIBLE

tessa: heads-up i'm oncall for product. i see a dedicated customer on that pool (acct: NuGrowth). we can't autorevert without notifying them / sales. can we hold autopolicy?

ops-bot: NOTE: Auto-revert policy active. Human hold can be set via `deploybot.hold=true` or via the console. If hold set, autorevert suppressed for current window.

leah: quick triage: are errors or kvcache misses? ben, any perf graphs?

ben: perf: kernel util normal, memory stable. logs show `kvcache.lock_retry` spikes and a few `embed_worker_timeout`. not widespread on generation routes, only embeddings.

ryan: i'm going to request a hold. tessa please ack if you want to notify cust/sales.

tessa: ack. please set hold. i'll ping account team and legal if needed.

ryan: setting `deploybot.hold=true` now -> done. deploy-bot: hold acknowledged.

deploy-bot: LOG: autorevert suppressed due to hold=true by ryan at 4470020492.

leah: since it's dedicated and a paid customer, prefer partial pin of embeddings to previous variant (v3.4.1) for that pool instead of full rollback. keeps other routes stable.

ryan: agree. planned command: `infractl route update --pool=eu-west2 --route=embeddings --variant=v3.4.1 --split=100% --note="dedicated-cust_stability_pin"`

ben: run it from staging first? this is the dedicated pool not canary. we should be quick.

qa-bot: REMINDER: run health checks after route update: /hc/embeddings -> expect 200 within 30s, p95 < 200ms baseline.

ryan: executing at 4470020505... `infractl route update` -> api: OK. health checks: 3/3 passing. p95 down to 180ms.

leah: nice. can someone post a short note to #customer-impact and CC sales? tessa, can you draft?

tessa: posted: "NuGrowth: We observed an embeddings latency regression in the EU dedicated pool. We've routed embeddings traffic to the previous stable variant (v3.4.1) to restore performance. No data exposure. We're investigating and will update within 1 hour."

ben: opened incident INC-2026-338 with logs, timestamps, and infractl commands. assigned to eng-runtime. initial RCA ETA 24h.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: Partial pin executed by ryan at 4470020505. Step: monitor 15m, escalate if p95 > baseline+20% for 3 consecutive minutes.

ryan: added deploy metadata: `rollback.partial=embeddings`, `rollback.scope=dedicated-eu-west2`, `operator=ryan`, `start=4470020505`.

deploy-bot: LOG: autorevert remains suppressed until `deploybot.hold` unset. Manual override required to re-enable.

tessa: i'll coordinate with account team and post an update to NuGrowth once eng-runtime has an RCA. leave hold in place for now.

leah: also add a release-notes draft: "Emergency pin of embeddings variant in eu-west2 dedicated pool to v3.4.1 due to transient KV contention. Investigating; we will include RCA in postmortem."

ops-bot: REMINDER: remember to unset hold after confirmed fix or planned re-roll. Unsetting without RC can allow autos to flip unexpectedly.

ryan: thanks all. closing thread for now. if anyone sees a repeat alert i'll reopen. :thumbsup:
